title: QUIC RFC 9000 Server 0-RTT Transport Parameter Acceptance Policy Work Item
summary: Close the bounded server 0-RTT transport-parameter acceptance policy floor by comparing remembered client values to current server values and rejecting unsupported, reduced, or missing restored parameters.
planned_changes:
- Extend QuicZeroRttTransportParameterPolicy with a server acceptance decision over remembered and current transport parameters.
- Reject reductions to required 0-RTT Section 18.2 limits and restored optional max_idle_timeout, max_udp_payload_size, and disable_active_migration values.
- Add a non-zero client application-data allowance helper for 0-RTT-relevant flow-control and stream-count parameters.
- Add focused S7P4P1 0005 through 0009 requirement-home tests for positive, negative, and edge coverage.
- Retarget S7P4P1 0005 through 0009 trace links to focused proof.
verification_plan: Run a Release build, run the focused S7P4P1 and CRT early-data guard filter, regenerate QUIC requirement coverage triage, validate SpecTrace JSON, run the full Release test suite without rebuilding, and check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
out_of_scope: RFC9000-S7-4-1-P4-S2-R01 client new-value and default-value consumption.
REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-S7P4P1-0010 through REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0356 updated-value-in-0-RTT sender and receiver enforcement.
completion_notes: Completed as a focused internal server 0-RTT transport-parameter acceptance policy and requirement-home proof for RFC9000-S7-4-1-P6-R01 through REQ-QUIC-RFC9000-0351.
